class.name: NNSTGuard
class.brief_description: Base class for all State Tree guard resources.
class.description: Guards decide whether a transition may be taken. Repeated evaluation of automatic transitions is driven by the trigger types a guard reports through [method get_supported_trigger_types].

method.name: is_satisfied
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the guard is satisfied, [code]false[/code] otherwise. Guards are used to determine if a transition can be taken or not. If the guard is satisfied, the transition can be taken.

method.name: get_supported_trigger_types
method.description: Returns a bit mask of [enum NNSTRoot.TriggerType] values describing which changes can affect this guard's result. Automatic transitions use this to decide when they need to be re-evaluated. The base implementation reports [constant NNSTRoot.NONE] and prints an error. Override this method in a GDScript guard to report the trigger types it depends on; without an override the guard's transitions are only checked on [constant NNSTRoot.STATE_ENTER] unless the transition's guard composition reports additional trigger types.
